task.description: Design and write the integration test for ISS-106 (the webhook_deliveries outbox table formalization). ISS-106 is a schema/migration requirement; its test must verify the migration produces the correct table shape against REAL PostgreSQL (BPM_TEST_DB_URL). Write a spec at tests/specs/ISS-106.md and an integration test (Zig) under tests/integration/ that asserts, in a fresh per-test schema/UUID fixture: (1) webhook_deliveries has the attempt column (INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0); (2) inserting a row with status in (PENDING,DELIVERED,FAILED,RETRYING) succeeds; (3) inserting a row with an out-of-domain status (e.g. 'BOGUS' or legacy 'pending') is REJECTED by the CHECK constraint; (4) the index idx_wd_status_next_attempt exists on (status, next_attempt_at); (5) a row with the full ISS-106 contract columns (delivery_id/id, subscription_id, event_id, status, attempt, next_attempt_at, last_error, created_at) round-trips. The transactional-outbox insert path and worker claim (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) are ISS-205 — do NOT test them here; the backlog explicitly defers the claim path to ISS-205. Follow docs/guides/test_developer_guide.md. Use per-test UUIDs; the test must fail clearly if BPM_TEST_DB_URL is absent; clean up via defer. Place DB-backed tests in tests/integration/ (NOT tests/unit/). Wire the new test into the integration test target if required.
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/ISS-106.md exists and maps each assertion to an ISS-106 acceptance criterion
A runnable integration test exists under tests/integration/ covering attempt column, status CHECK accept+reject, index presence, and contract round-trip
No error.SkipZigTest on the ISS-106 coverage
Per-test UUID fixtures; cleanup via defer; clear failure if BPM_TEST_DB_URL absent
ISS-205 claim/outbox path explicitly NOT included

result.summary: Designed and wrote the ISS-106 integration test verifying the migration-085 webhook_deliveries outbox table shape against real PostgreSQL. 5 assertions: attempt column type/nullability/default, valid status domain accept, out-of-domain (BOGUS + legacy lowercase pending) reject via CHECK, worker-claim index presence on (status,next_attempt_at), full-contract row round-trip. Per-test tenant-schema fixtures with random UUIDs; defer cleanup; clear failure if BPM_TEST_DB_URL absent. ISS-205 outbox-insert/claim path NOT tested.
